incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-82713 - prom_scrape_job_missing (severity: P1). Notify: @oncall.
pagerduty: Incident PD-82713 created: prom_scrape_job_missing. Triggered by alert rule: prometheus.prom_scrape_job_up == 0 for >2m.
jamie: acked PD-82713. I'm on it.
mike: Thanks Jamie. Quick summary?
jamie: Grafana shows a cluster of scrape targets for 'redwood/service-metrics' flipping to DOWN at ~1789801200. Same time we see tail of high requeue in redis-forwarder queue.
sara: Seeing log-forwarder backlog on the infra node too. redis INFO shows instantaneous_ops_in_progress spike. Could be backpressure -> Prom scrape timeout.
leo: can you paste the top errors from prometheus scrape logs?
jamie: Paste: ```level=error ts=2026-03-14T15:06:12.123Z caller=scrape.go:987 component="scrape" target="http://10.42.7.19:9090/metrics" msg="context deadline exceeded"```
mike: Thanks. Are all failing targets in same AZ?
jamie: Yes - all in us-west-2a. Network flaps? I ran `kubectl get pods -n metrics -o wide` and see the log-forwarder (forwarder-redis-0) with CrashLoopBackoff on node ip-10-0-7-85 around the same time.
sara: I can tail redis queue: `redis-cli -h redis-main info` shows `blocked_clients: 120` and `aof_pending_bio_fsync: 0` but memory fragmentation is high. Might be slow client causing backlog.
leo: Rolling restart forwarder? Might be quick mitigation to clear stuck clients. Any warmup impact? Some spikes to user-facing metrics but not full outage.
jamie: Doing a controlled restart of forwarder on node 10-0-7-85: `kubectl rollout restart statefulset/forwarder-redis -n infra`
opsbot: deploy-bot: rollout restart initiated for statefulset/forwarder-redis in infra (uid: rc-582). Monitoring pods.
pagerduty: PD-82713 acknowledged by jamie. Escalation halted.
mike: While restarting, let's apply a temporary scrape_override to reduce concurrency for prometheus on those targets to avoid hammering. I added a rule to Prometheus: `job_name: 'service-metrics' scrape_interval: 30s scrape_timeout: 10s` (was 15s/5s).
sara: Good call. Also throttling forwarding: increased `max_inflight` for forwarder to 50 from 200? Actually we should reduce concurrency to give redis a chance. I set `FORWARDER_MAX_INFLIGHT=40` via configmap and reloaded forwarder.
jamie: New forwarder pod is running. Logs show reconnect: `INFO reconnecting to redis, pending 0`. Prom scrapes for service-metrics back to UP at ~1789801310.
leo: Any customer impact? Ops - do we have SLO alerts?
mike: Quick check: only a handful of service-level dashboards showed partial metric loss for internal telemetry; no external API errors reported. I ran synthetic checks for inference endpoints — latencies are within SLO. That suggests limited downstream customer impact.
jamie: Noting impacted metric types: `request_rate` and `kvcache_miss` for that service during the window 1789801190-1789801310. We'll annotate incident timeline.
sara: Root cause hypothesis: forwarder experienced client-side stall (redis blocked clients) causing backlog -> Prometheus scrapes timed out -> alerts fired. Could be memory fragmentation or transient network hiccup on node.
leo: Next steps: 1) Keep forwarder restarted and monitor for 30m, 2) Run `redis-cli --latency` and check `slowlog`, 3) Schedule postmortem if repeats.
jamie: I've added a short-term remediation playbook to the incident ticket and pinned logs to the thread. Also adding a Grafana annotation for the outage window.
opsbot: incident-bot: PD-82713 status updated to RESOLVED by jamie at 1789801372. Note: automated escalation cancelled.
mike: Great work. Please add action items: - Increase redis monitoring for blocked_clients, - Add alert for forwarder CrashLoopBackoff, - Consider connection pool tuning.
sara: I'll own the follow-up to check redis memory fragmentation and possible client library upgrade.
leo: I'll draft a short postmortem if we see recurrence. For now close the thread in 1h if green. :thumbsup:
jamie: Closing ack here, will reopen if anything pops. Thanks everyone.
